botcomponent.description: Use when the user asks any natural-language analytics question over Azure Data Explorer / Kusto data (for example "what was the error rate last week", "top 10 tables by row count", "busiest hour for errors") and a Cluster and Database are already set. Do NOT use for requests to write, delete, update, ingest, or administer data, or for requests unrelated to data analysis — refuse those instead.
botcomponent.name: kusto-query-interpreter
